titulo: The four files that board with you
subtitulo: Passport, the booking you can prove offline, a working connection and two ways to pay — checked tonight, while fixing them is still cheap
cena: Tonight, on the kitchen table, is the last moment any of this is easy to fix — tomorrow it all lives in a phone that might have no signal.
frasePiso: If the phone dies at the taxi rank, the trip should still exist in your hand.

steps.pt: Tomorrow's trip starts tonight. Four files, checked while a mistake still costs nothing to fix.
One: the passport, and your airline's own validity rule — the airline's boarding check and the border's rule are not the same thing.
Two: make the booking survive a dead phone. Save the hotel address and the return ticket somewhere that works with no signal.
Good evening, how can I help you?

steps.promptPt: You are calling the hotel before flying. Open with the job. Speak now.
steps.pt: I'd like to confirm my booking.
A green tick inside an app is not proof. Ask for the confirmation somewhere you can keep it.

steps.promptPt: Ask them to send the confirmation by email so you can save it offline. Speak now.
steps.es: Mi può mandare la conferma per email?
steps.pinyin: mee pwoh man-DA-re la kon-FER-ma per EE-mayl
steps.pt: Can you send me the confirmation by email?
steps.tts: Mi può mandare la conferma per email?

steps.pt: A hotel name is not a destination. A driver and an offline map need the full street address.

steps.promptPt: The booking shows only the hotel name. Ask for the complete address. Speak now.
steps.pt: What is the full address?
Via Garibaldi forty-two, second floor.

steps.promptPt: You will not remember that. Ask for it in writing. Speak now.
steps.pt: Can you write it down for me?
Three: connection. Install the eSIM at home, and keep the activation steps somewhere readable without connection.
Four: two ways to pay, both tested by you. Cards decline abroad for reasons nobody explains at the counter.

steps.promptPt: Your flight lands late. Say when you arrive and check reception is open. Speak now.
steps.es: Arrivo dopo le undici. La reception è aperta?
steps.pinyin: ar-REE-vo DO-po le OON-dee-chee. la re-SEP-shon eh a-PER-ta
steps.pt: I arrive after eleven. Is reception open?
steps.tts: Arrivo dopo le undici. La reception è aperta?

steps.pt: Yes, we're open twenty-four hours.

steps.promptPt: Get a phone number you can call from the airport. Speak now.
steps.pt: What is the hotel's phone number?

steps.promptPt: Ask them to hold the booking until you arrive. Speak now.
steps.pt: Can you hold the booking for me?

steps.promptPt: Close the call warmly. Speak now.
steps.pt: Perfect, thank you. See you soon!

steps.es: Vorrei confermare la mia prenotazione. Qual è l'indirizzo completo? Me lo può scrivere?
steps.pinyin: vor-RAY kon-fer-MA-re la MEE-a pre-no-ta-tsee-O-ne. kwal eh leen-dee-REET-tso kom-PLEH-to. meh lo pwoh SKREE-veh-re
steps.pt: Shadow the whole pre-flight call in one run.
steps.tts: Vorrei confermare la mia prenotazione. Qual è l'indirizzo completo? Me lo può scrivere?

steps.pt: B04 done. Passport checked, booking confirmed and saved offline, full address in writing, connection and two payment methods tested.

secoes.corpo: A screenshot of the address, the return booking and the eSIM steps survives airport wifi, a locked account and a dead battery in ways a chain of app links does not.

secoes.titulo: The airline rule and the border rule differ
secoes.corpo: Passport validity is checked twice by two different parties with two different rules. Meeting the border's requirement does not guarantee the airline will board you — check both before you leave for the airport.

secoes.titulo: Confirmation is an action, not a document
secoes.corpo: The useful Italian here does not list your papers. It closes the fragile gaps in the booking before departure: confirm it, get the full address, get it in writing.

exemplos.pt: I'd like to confirm my booking.

secoes.titulo: Italian addresses put the number after the street
secoes.corpo: Via Garibaldi 42, not 42 Via Garibaldi. Written down it is unambiguous, which is exactly why the writing rung of B03 earns its place here.

permissao: You are allowed to over-prepare this one. Confirming a booking twice or saving an address you will probably never need is not anxious behaviour — it is the one part of the trip where five minutes tonight buys real protection against a dead phone or a closed front desk.
espelho: Anyone who has ever printed a boarding pass 'just in case' the airline app fails is already running this instinct, just for one document. B04 asks for the same offline-backup habit applied to three more — not a new kind of caution, the familiar one extended.

fichasCulturais.sinal: You land, open the map to find the hotel, and there is no signal and nothing cached beyond the hotel's name.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: I should have bought roaming, or this trip is already going wrong.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: A hotel name is not routable. A driver or an offline map needs the street and the number, and in Italian cities the same street name recurs across towns, so the city matters too.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Before flying, ask for the full address in writing and save it somewhere that works with no signal — not only inside a booking app.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: A driver, a stranger or an offline map can all act on it immediately, instead of you standing at arrivals holding a brand name.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not a substitute for confirming the booking itself — a perfect address for the wrong reservation is still the wrong reservation.
